Context: VII. Disability Pension for cases under Category 'E'

## VII. Disability Pension for cases under Category 'E'  
- (a) Disability pension would comprise of a service element equal to 50% of the notional pay as on 1-1-2016 and disability element equal to the same notional pay as on 1-1-2016 for 100% disability.
- (b) For lower percentage of the disability, the disability element shall be proportionately lower subject to the provisions of Rule 8 of CCS (EOP) Rules.
